title: The Bay of Bengal
info: The Bay of Bengal is the northeastern part of the Indian Ocean.
Bangladesh's coast faces this bay. Cox's Bazar is famous for a very long sandy beach.
Storms from the bay can bring heavy rain and dangerous surges of seawater.
